bullets: Apply monotonically increase function Φ on Loss function L(x) ⇒ Φ(L(x))
when L(x) is minimized ⇒ Φ(L(x)) is minimized
Conclusion: instead of using Loss function L(x) during training , one can use Φ(L(x))
where Φ is any monotonically increase function
We will use (1/2)L(x) instead of L(x) during minimization (to Simplify Math operations)
